description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing account transfers within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving transfer templates, creating transfers, listing transfers, retrieving specific transfer details, and processing refunds. The class is annotated for Swagger documentation and uses JAX-RS annotations for RESTful web services.

classes.name: AccountTransfersApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for account transfer operations, including template retrieval, creation, listing, and refunds.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Retrieves a transfer template with default values and options based on search parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new account transfer based on the provided transfer request.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Lists all account transfers with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific transfer by its ID.

methods.name: templateRefundByTransfer
methods.description: Retrieves a refund template for an active loan transfer.

methods.name: templateRefundByTransferPost
methods.description: Processes a refund of an active loan transfer.
